title: Resume
text:
Sustainability Analyst (Data Management Lead) · The Resource Group · Remote
January 2025 – Present

Lead data management for the Environmental Impact Office, the company’s sustainability team.
Reduced proxy data in the carbon emissions inventory by 83% from baseline by building a Python process that matches utility accounts to property accounts.
Calculate Scope 1, 2 and 3 greenhouse gas emissions and maintain audit-ready emissions reporting.
Build dashboards and visualizations that give site-level teams visibility into their sustainability metrics and drive friendly competition between sites.
Automate data review, data auditing and recurring Google Workspace tasks to cut manual work.

Tools: R, Python, SQL, Tableau, Excel
